description: This file defines the MarkdownBodyPartHandler class, which handles rendering of Markdown content in OrchardCore CMS. It processes Markdown to HTML, applies Liquid templates, shortcodes, and sanitization, and sets the HTML content for display.

classes.name: MarkdownBodyPartHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing MarkdownBodyPart content, converting Markdown to HTML, applying Liquid templates, shortcodes, and sanitization.

methods.name: MarkdownBodyPartHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for handling Markdown content.

methods.name: GetContentItemAspectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a MarkdownBodyPart to generate HTML, applying Liquid templates, shortcodes, and sanitization, and assigns it to the BodyAspect.
